issues.t: Five MSK lifecycle families still reach no verdict: VPC-connection, replicator, channel, cluster-operation and SCRAM-revocation sequences all time out with nothing asserted (5 causes)
MSK serverless cluster surface diverges: provisioned ARN suffix, dropped securityGroupIds, non-own bootstrap host and an omitted invalidParameter (4 causes)
Implement kafka UpdateRebalancing: unimplemented scaffold stub
MSK bootstrap endpoints are published as real AWS broker DNS names the emulator does not serve, and two delete refusals carry emulator prose (3 causes)
UpdateChannel on a deleted channel answers 400 BadRequestException (invalid link ARN) instead of 404 NotFoundException, so one gone channel yields two codes across the channel lifecycle
BatchAssociateScramSecret reports the default-KMS-key rejection under ErrorCode InvalidSecretKmsKeyId instead of AWS's InvalidSecretArn
CreateClusterV2's unsupported-KafkaVersion refusal offers versions MSK no longer supports for standard brokers (3.6.0, 3.7.x, 3.7.x.kraft), and the same set is accepted
Three more MSK data-plane checks reach no verdict: nothing accepts a connection on the advertised SASL/SCRAM bootstrap endpoint

Two more MSK checks never reach a verdict: the UpdateMonitoring lifecycle and the single-partition ordering round-trip both time out (2 causes)
MSK cluster-state guard on UpdateBrokerStorage/UpdateMonitoring/UpdateSecurity emits emulator prose, and it pre-empts the CurrentVersion parameter check (2 causes)
kafka: every native MSK data-plane check is blocked — the Lambda Python runtime's `os` module lacks register_at_fork, so the in-VPC probe handler dies with Runtime.ImportModuleError
Channel unicode round-trip never reaches a verdict: CreateClusterV2/CreateTopic/CreateChannel transitions are clock-owed, so an AWS-cadence poller is charged a full interval per transition

CreateChannel: a duplicate channel name is refused as ConflictException instead of BadRequestException, and an out-of-range DataFreshnessInSeconds is accepted (2 causes)

CreateConfiguration's unsupported-KafkaVersion refusal renders the wrong valid-value list: catalog order instead of MSK's order, and an extra version MSK does not offer (2 causes)
CreateConfiguration's unsupported-KafkaVersions refusal Message is the emulator's own prose and omits the valid-value list (2 causes)

MSK cluster-mutation refusals answer the wrong error class and message wording
UpdateBrokerCount validates targetNumberOfBrokerNodes before resolving the cluster: an over-range target on a nonexistent cluster answers BadRequestException instead of NotFoundException
MSK refusal gates are skipped on mutation paths: UpdateConnectivity answers not-found instead of the authorization denial, and CreateReplicator accepts an out-of-range subnetIds list (2 causes)
MSK version catalog is stale: ListKafkaVersions and GetCompatibleKafkaVersions diverge from the published catalog

CreateConfiguration accepts a Name outside MSK's allowed character set (spaces and punctuation) and mints an ACTIVE configuration
MSK resource authorization is never evaluated, so denied requests answer not-found or succeed (10 causes)
MSK read paths serve invented version catalogs and replicator projections (4 causes)
MSK not-found, already-exists and tagging refusals use the wrong class and wording (10 causes)

MSK invalid-value refusals on operation, secret, VPC-connection and pagination inputs carry emulator prose (9 causes)
MSK error payloads name the Smithy member instead of the modeled invalidParameter wire name (9 causes)
MSK create and update inputs AWS refuses are accepted, and refusal order is wrong (8 causes)
MSK configuration timestamps serialize as epoch numbers instead of ISO-8601 date-times (6 causes)
